analysis: Independent device-level heat-balance validation using public YbNi1.6Sn data

article.title: Metallic local-moment magnetocalorics as a route to cryogenic refrigeration

reported_device_facts.device_description: pressed YbNi1.6Sn powder in a thin-wall brass can with RuO2 thermometer and thin-film heater

supplement.basis: Supplementary Note 6 reports alpha_0T = 4.4 mJ K mol^-1 Yb for C_n/T = alpha T^-3.

dataset.title: Supporting data for Metallic local-moment magnetocalorics, a new route to cryogenic refrigeration

files_used.Fig02_0p0T.dat: zero-field electronic molar heat capacity and entropy
files_used.Fig04b_172mK.dat: warm-up curve labelled 9 T initial field and 2.5 microW heat input
files_used.Fig04b_192mK.dat: warm-up curve labelled 9 T initial field and 5 microW heat input

declared_analysis_protocol.calibration_role: fit one common effective refrigerant mass and one common steady parasitic heat load from both load curves
declared_analysis_protocol.holdout_role: test the fitted parameters at temperatures not used for fitting
declared_analysis_protocol.energy_identity: (applied load + parasitic load) * elapsed time = (effective mass / molar mass) * integral(C_elec + C_n) dT
declared_analysis_protocol.interpretation_limit: This validates the lumped heat-balance translation on an independent material and device. It does not validate NBCP-specific heat-switch, contact, ramp, or addenda losses.
